children: Joshi takes on the marketing leadership role after serving as President and Head of Corporate Planning and Group Strategy, bringing over 20 years of cross-sector experience

Uno Minda has elevated Kartikeya Joshi to Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), following his tenure as President and Head of Corporate Planning and Group Strategy at the company. Joshi brings over 20 years of experience across the automotive and health-tech sectors, with a career spanning corporate strategy, planning and business leadership.

Before his elevation, Joshi served as President and Head of Corporate Planning and Group Strategy at Uno Minda. His appointment to the CMO role marks a shift from his previous focus on corporate planning and group strategy to marketing leadership.
The company has not disclosed further details about his new responsibilities or the scope of his marketing mandate.

Joshi has more than two decades of professional experience across the automotive and health-tech industries. His career includes roles at Curo Healthcare, Bosch Chassis Systems India, Philips, and Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions.

His experience across these organisations spans sectors with distinct business models and operating environments. His move into the CMO role brings his corporate planning and strategy experience to the company's marketing leadership.

Before his latest elevation, Joshi held positions at several established companies, including Bosch Chassis Systems India and Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions. He also worked with Philips and Curo Healthcare, adding health-tech experience to his automotive-sector background.
His career progression at Uno Minda, from leading corporate planning and group strategy to taking on the CMO position, places him in a marketing leadership role at the company.
The appointment marks Joshi's latest career move after more than 20 years of experience across automotive and health-tech businesses.
